title: Aurora Acceptance: A Collaborative Exascale Test Harness
problem: Deploying exascale supercomputers requires comprehensive acceptance testing to verify system stability, correctness, and performance. Aurora at ALCF required extensive validation process coordinating vendor and facility efforts.
motivation: Exascale systems represent massive investment and must meet performance and reliability requirements before general user access. Acceptance testing mitigates deployment risks by thoroughly stressing components and tracking regressions. Previous ALCF systems used acceptance harness needing extension for Aurora.
method: Extended open-source acceptance test harness from previous ALCF systems to Aurora, supporting: (1) Comprehensive component and system-level testing, (2) Real-world utilization simulation, (3) Regression tracking, (4) Multiple testing modes.
key_novelty: Demonstrated successful deployment testing of Aurora exascale system through collaborative vendor-facility process. Provides reusable testing framework and lessons learned for future exascale deployments.
contributions: Extended acceptance test harness supporting Aurora's unique architecture and components
Comprehensive testing methodology covering component-level and system-level validation
Regression tracking and system stability verification framework
Documentation of challenges, lessons learned, and future enhancement opportunities
limitations: Abstract-only; specific test suite details, defect statistics, and performance validation results not provided.
primary_theme: Exascale system validation and acceptance testing
